program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0))])
      (let* ((rs (map first (obj-cells obj)))
             (cs (map second (obj-cells obj))))
        (cond
          [(= (apply min rs) (apply max rs)) (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) 4)]
          [(= (apply min cs) (apply max cs)) (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) 7)]
          [else out]))))
